A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided the 1H and 13C backbone and side chain resonance assignment of Crl, a protein involved in the general stress response in Salmonella.
we provide the resonance assignments for a 13.8-kDa protein, which is a member of the large class of anti-sigma factors.
we have assigned 98% of the backbone and 97% of side-chain resonances of Crl, including 100% of all backbone and side-chain resonances in the N-terminal domain (residues 1–50) of Crl.
